canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Ora Falen: 25-year-old woman, 154 cm (very-short), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-4-medium. Face: angular diamond face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: asymmetric-patchwork, specifically intentional patchwork layers with an uneven hem, visible repairs, and practical trousers; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette moss-ivory. Visible personal details: an extensive matte botanical tattoo language over one shoulder, torso edge, and forearm. Make the hair construction the primary recognition silhouette. Maintenance cue: low-maintenance grooming with highly polished footwear. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a travel tally cord only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
